title: Corporate & Commercial Law
shortDescription: Legal support for businesses, commercial transactions, and corporate matters.
description: Support with corporate documentation, commercial contracts, business structuring, and legal issues arising from commercial operations.
details: Assistance with commercial agreements and business documentation.
Legal review of contractual terms and business arrangements.
Support with corporate compliance matters, subject to the applicable law.

title: Civil Litigation
shortDescription: Assistance with civil disputes, claims, and court proceedings.
description: Legal assistance concerning civil disputes, contractual claims, property-related disputes, and other civil proceedings.
details: Review of dispute-related documents and relevant facts.
Assessment of potential legal remedies and procedural options.
Preparation and assistance with litigation documentation.

title: Criminal Law
shortDescription: Legal assistance for criminal complaints, defence, and related proceedings.
description: Assistance with understanding criminal procedure, evaluating case documents, and navigating applicable legal proceedings.
details: Preliminary review of case facts and available documents.
Guidance on relevant procedural steps and legal options.
Assistance with legal documentation and proceedings where engaged.

title: Family Law
shortDescription: Legal assistance for matrimonial, family, and related disputes.
description: Guidance on family-law matters, including matrimonial disputes, maintenance, and other issues governed by applicable family laws.
details: Initial review of the circumstances and relevant documents.
Explanation of potential legal options and procedures.
Assistance with family-law documentation and proceedings.

title: Property & Real Estate Law
shortDescription: Support with property documents, ownership disputes, and real estate matters.
description: Legal assistance with property documentation, ownership issues, property transactions, and real estate disputes.
details: Review of available property documents and agreements.
Identification of relevant legal and documentation issues.
Assistance with property-related disputes and transactions.

title: Contract Drafting & Review
shortDescription: Drafting and review assistance for contracts and legal agreements.
description: Assistance with preparing, reviewing, and understanding contractual terms for business and personal transactions.
details: Review of proposed contractual terms and obligations.
Identification of ambiguous clauses and potential risks.
Drafting assistance based on the parties' requirements.
